The climate in Luxembourg

Luxembourg is about 320 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 24°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 0°C. Around 880 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 92 mm). The highest temperature in Luxembourg in 2015–2024 was 36°C (25 July 2019) and the lowest −11°C (18 January 2016).

Best time to visit Luxembourg

The most pleasant weather in Luxembourg is usually in June, July and August: average highs are between 22°C and 24°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month.
